adoption_note: v41.0.0 is an unreleased, in-progress W4 and W3 contract allocation on storage S1. S1 retains its discriminators and level-1 field shapes, but level-1 producer bytes changed in the refreshed capture: ordinary ContentLabels.source moved to the S1 default [] from the earlier local capture's ["internal"], changing affected ContentRef MACs and dependent digests; the principal-attributes case remains explicit ["internal"]. Typed session creation bootstrap and pre-turn inbox requirements are L2 only, and the single sk_session cache is recomputed under existing transaction and lease fences. Its existing level column combines the monotonic envelope-format floor with applicable routing requirement levels, so L2 history does not fall to level 1 after turn end. L3 is limited to existing turn_started, op_planned, op_prepared and provider_evidence shapes for W3 environment binding, stable execution identity, final post-hook command digest and authenticated encrypted provider lookup; no record kind, execution store, registry, proxy or parallel outcome enum is added. Format remains a reader and executor gate; only execution supports are waived for thin readers, and L2 workers/readers reject L3 bodies before decode. trusted_storage_s1.json has deterministic real-producer evidence from two byte-identical clean runs at Python revision a5061281b95e92c528ea96c4b46dd57c28280b9b; it is not immutable adoption evidence. worker_compatibility.json and execution_worker_w3.json remain contract-allocation-only with no producer capture or adoption evidence. Neither v40.0.0 nor v41.0.0 has an immutable release or published artifact; Python lock/snapshot synchronization, complete implementation gates and the central cross-repository workflow remain pending. The frozen Rust entry stays at contract 23.0.0 / package series 0.21.x; no DDL migration, second drain, compatibility reader, alias or dual format is defined.
